newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Belle sees 1996 net at 870 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Belle sees 1996 net at 870 mln pesos.

text.p: Gaming and property concern Belle Corp expects its net profit for full year 1996 to reach 870 million pesos, a 54 percent jump from last year's 566 million pesos, company chairman Jaime Gonzalez tolf Reuters on Friday.
Gonzalez said the bulk of Belle's earnings will come from the sale of residential projects and playing rights in Tagaytay Highlands, a leisure complex south of Manila.
During the company's special meeting on Friday, shareholders approved the increse in the company's authorised capital stock to 20 billion pesos from 4.0 billion.
They also approved the issuance of 5.0 billion pesos worth of preferred shares which will be privately placed. These preferred shares will earn an annual dividend of 9.75 percent.
For this year, the company has set its capital expenditure at 700 million pesos for its property projects, Eric Recto, Belle's chief finance officer said.
Next year, he said the capital outlay could increase to 1.5 billion pesos due to its planned casino operations.
In September, Belle signed a memorandum of agreement with Malaysia's Metroplex Bhd to jointly undertake the construction and development of a casino and hotel at Belle Bay Plaza in Manila.
